# UIComponent

*Client*

Base of all components of a script UI: ID, position and size (in pixels or relative to the parent), anchor, margins, visibility, tooltip, mouse callbacks and custom values. Setters return the component, so calls can be chained.

## Methods

### getScramElement {#getscramelement}

::: member

**Returns** `T` — the BBS element of this component, for Java code; scripts rarely need it

:::

### id {#id}

::: member

Gives the component an ID, to find it later with `ui.getComponent(id)` or animate it.

```js
ui.label("Score: 0").id("score");
// later
ui.getComponent("score").label("Score: 10");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | ID, unique within the UI |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

### x {#x}

::: member

Places the left edge (see [`anchorX`](#anchorx)) at a distance from the left edge of the parent.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `offset` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | distance in pixels |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

### rx {#rx}

::: member

Places the component at a part of the parent's width.

```js
ui.button("OK").rx(0.5).anchorX(0.5); // centered horizontally
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | 0 is the parent's left edge, 1 its right edge |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

### rx {#rx-2}

::: member

Places the component at a part of the parent's width plus an offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | 0 is the parent's left edge, 1 its right edge |
| `offset` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | added distance in pixels; negative moves left |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

::: member

Sets the width as a part of the parent's width plus an offset.

| `offset` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | added width in pixels; negative makes it narrower |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

### anchor {#anchor}

::: member

Sets the same anchor on both axes, see [`anchor(float, float)`](#anchor).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | 0 is the left/top edge, 0.5 the center, 1 the right/bottom edge |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

### anchor {#anchor-2}

::: member

Sets which point of the component is placed at its position: 0 is its left/top edge, 0.5 its center, 1 its right/bottom edge.

```js
ui.label("Paused").rxy(0.5, 0.5).anchor(0.5, 0.5); // centered in the parent
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | anchor along the width |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | anchor along the height |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

### enabled {#enabled}

::: member

Enables or disables the component; a disabled one ignores the mouse and keys.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the component reacts to input |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

### isEnabled {#isenabled}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the component reacts to input

:::

### visible {#visible}

::: member

Shows or hides the component; a hidden one is not drawn and ignores input.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `visible` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the component is shown |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

### isVisible {#isvisible}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the component is shown

:::

### culling {#culling}

::: member

Sets whether the component is skipped while it is outside the visible area of its parent (e.g. a scrolled list). On by default; turn it off for components that draw beyond their own bounds.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `culling` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether a component out of view is not drawn |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

::: member

Shows a tooltip on one side of the component, wrapped to a width.

| `label` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | tooltip text |

| `direction` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | `"TOP"`, `"BOTTOM"`, `"LEFT"` or `"RIGHT"` |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

### noTooltip {#notooltip}

### mouseClicked {#mouseclicked}

::: member

Calls a function when a mouse button is pressed over the component. The callback runs for any mouse button, also when other components lie over this one.

```js
ui.label("Click me").mouseClicked(function (label) {
    label.label("Clicked");
});
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `consumer` | `Function<UIComponent<?>>` | function that gets this component |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

### mousePressed {#mousepressed}

::: member

Stores a function for mouse presses. Script screens do not call it yet; use [`mouseClicked`](#mouseclicked) instead.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `consumer` | `Function<UIComponent<?>>` | function that gets this component |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

### mouseReleased {#mousereleased}

::: member

Calls a function when a mouse button is released over the component. The callback runs for any mouse button, also when other components lie over this one.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `consumer` | `Function<UIComponent<?>>` | function that gets this component |

**Returns** `UIComponent<T>` — this component

:::

### mouseScrolled {#mousescrolled}

::: member

Calls a function when the mouse wheel turns over the component. The callback runs for any mouse button, also when other components lie over this one.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `consumer` | `Function<UIComponent<?>>` | function that gets this component |

::: member

### getValue {#getvalue}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | value name |

**Returns** `Any` — value stored with [`setValue`](#setvalue), or null if there is none

:::

### setValue {#setvalue}

::: member

Stores any value on the component, e.g. to find out in a callback which item a button stands for.

```js
ui.button("Buy").setValue("price", 10);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | value name |
| `value` | `Any` | value to store, or null to clear it |

:::
